offering_description.value: Promotes concerts and festivals for fans by booking performers and staging shows at venues it operates or hires. It sells and resells event tickets through its platform for venues, promoters, and sports organizations, and sells sponsorships and advertising to brands.

primary_products.value: artist and event merchandise; food and beverages at venues

primary_services.value: concert and festival promotion; venue operations; primary and resale ticketing; sponsorship and advertising; artist management

customer_segment.value: B2C: Concertgoers, festival attendees, and other live-event ticket buyers; B2B: Artists, venue operators, event promoters, sports organizations, and brand advertisers

end_markets.value: live music and festivals; sports; theater and other live entertainment; brand marketing

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Concert admission and fees on primary ticket sales and resale transactions; advertising: Event and venue sponsorships, brand activations, and digital advertising placements; product sales: Artist and event merchandise, food, and beverages; commissions or management fees: Artist representation and management
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; advertising; product sales; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Books artists and produces shows for fans, manages artists, and sells sponsorships to brands; asset operator: Runs owned and leased venues and hosts events for fans and promoters; software / platform: Lists event inventory from rights holders and resale sellers for ticket buyers; retailer: Sells merchandise and concessions to event attendees
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; software / platform; retailer

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Concert promotion, venue operations, ticketing, sponsorship and advertising, and artist management

distribution_channels.value: online: Company ticketing websites and mobile apps for primary sales and resale; own locations: Box offices and on-site sales at company-operated venues and festivals; partners / resellers: Ticketing integrations with client venues and event organizers; direct sales: Sales teams serving ticketing clients, sponsors, and advertisers
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Antitrust oversight, consumer ticketing rules, data privacy requirements, and venue safety and alcohol licensing rules
